list.name: org
list.label: Organization
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM organizations ORDER BY name

panels.title: Team spend this month vs budget (USD)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.name AS team, COALESCE(SUM(u.cost_usd), 0)::numeric AS spend_usd, l.monthly_budget_usd AS budget_usd, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.cost_status IN ('usage_missing','stream_incomplete')) AS unpriced FROM teams t LEFT JOIN usage_team_budgets l ON l.team_id=t.id LEFT JOIN usage_records u ON u.team_id=t.id AND u.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') WHERE t.organization_id = ${org:sqlstring}::uuid GROUP BY t.id, t.name, l.monthly_budget_usd ORDER BY spend_usd DESC

SELECT provider || '/' || model AS model, SUM(cost_usd)::numeric AS cost_usd FROM usage_records WHERE organization_id = ${org:sqlstring}::uuid AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY provider, model ORDER BY cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), COUNT(*) AS requests FROM usage_records WHERE organization_id = ${org:sqlstring}::uuid AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens),0) + COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens),0) AS tokens FROM usage_records WHERE organization_id = ${org:sqlstring}::uuid AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cache hit ratio and estimated savings

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.name AS team, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.outcome='cache_hit') AS cache_hits, COUNT(u.id) AS requests, CASE WHEN COUNT(u.id)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.outcome='cache_hit')::numeric / COUNT(u.id), 4) END AS hit_ratio, COALESCE(SUM(u.saved_usd),0)::numeric AS saved_usd FROM teams t LEFT JOIN usage_records u ON u.team_id=t.id AND $__timeFilter(u.created_at) WHERE t.organization_id = ${org:sqlstring}::uuid GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY saved_usd DESC

SELECT t.name AS team, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.cost_status='usage_missing') AS usage_missing, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.cost_status='stream_incomplete') AS stream_incomplete FROM teams t LEFT JOIN usage_records u ON u.team_id=t.id AND $__timeFilter(u.created_at) WHERE t.organization_id = ${org:sqlstring}::uuid GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC
